item.text: The tools use PA12 with a solid Young’s modulus of 1.7 GPa. The initial scan found cube-and-bar candidates close to both limits, but their numerical uncertainty crosses the requirements. I’m refining the search before certification.

The refined search found no candidate that clears both limits with conservative error allowances. I’m certifying the closest atlas candidate to check whether it meets the requirements at higher resolution.
